messages.subject: Dr R Whitmore — Without Prejudice
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

Please find our without-prejudice letter setting out an opening offer of £120,000 plus a contribution to your client's legal fees, in full and final settlement and without admission of liability. The offer is open for 21 days.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Dr R Whitmore — Without Prejudice
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Marchetti,

Our client is disappointed by the level of the opening offer, which does not reflect the strength of the s.103A claim or the schedule of loss. She would, however, prefer to resolve matters. We are instructed to indicate that a figure in the region of £210,000 would be acceptable, but our client recognises the need for movement on both sides. Perhaps a call would help.

Eleanor Bartlett
